learn.hook: How far does the tip of a clock's minute hand travel in 20 minutes? Arc length gives the exact answer!
points: Circumference of a circle = 2πr and its area = πr².
An arc is a part of the circle. A minor arc is shorter than a semicircle; a major arc is longer.
An arc that makes angle θ at the centre is θ/360 of the whole circle.
Clock facts: the minute hand turns 360° in 60 minutes, so 6° every minute.

example.q: Find the length of an arc that makes 60° at the centre of a circle of radius 21 cm. (π = 22/7)

learn.reallife: Running tracks are curved arcs — race officials use arc lengths to stagger the starting lines fairly.

quiz.q: What is the length of an arc that makes 45° at the centre of a circle of radius 14 cm? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: 45° is 1/8 of the circle. Circumference = 2 × 22/7 × 14 = 88 cm, so the arc = 88 ÷ 8 = 11 cm.
quiz.mistake: Uses the area formula πr² instead of 2πr

quiz.q: A clock's minute hand is 21 cm long. How far does its tip travel in 20 minutes? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: In 20 minutes the hand turns 120°, which is 1/3 of a circle. 1/3 × 2 × 22/7 × 21 = 44 cm.
quiz.mistake: Uses the whole circumference (132 cm)

quiz.q: An arc of a circle of radius 7 cm is 22 cm long. What angle does it make at the centre? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: Circumference = 44 cm. The arc is 22/44 = 1/2 of it, so θ = 180°.
quiz.mistake: Uses the diameter instead of the circumference

quiz.q: The circumference of a circle is 88 cm. What is its radius? (π = 22/7)
quiz.mistake: Finds the diameter (28 cm) instead of the radius

quiz.q: In a circle of radius 7 cm, a minor arc makes 90° at the centre. What is the length of the major arc? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: The major arc makes 360° − 90° = 270°. Its length = 270/360 × 44 = 33 cm.
quiz.mistake: Gives the minor arc (11 cm)

quiz.q: A bicycle wheel has radius 35 cm. How far does it roll in 10 complete turns? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: One turn = 2 × 22/7 × 35 = 220 cm. Ten turns = 2200 cm = 22 m.
quiz.mistake: Converts centimetres to metres wrongly

quiz.q: Which formula gives the length of an arc making angle θ at the centre?
quiz.explain: An arc is the fraction θ/360 of the whole circumference 2πr.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up arc length with sector area

quiz.q: A pendulum 42 cm long swings through an angle of 60°. How long is the arc its tip travels? (π = 22/7)
quiz.mistake: Divides by 12 instead of 6, or forgets to take the fraction

teach.ask: Gappu watches the clock's minute hand: 'How far does its tip move in 15 minutes?'
teach.praise: Tweet! The angle out of 360, times the circumference. The tip's journey is solved!
teach.nudge: What fraction of the full circle is the arc, and what do I multiply that fraction by?

learn.hook: Cut a round pizza into slices — each slice is a sector, and you can find its exact area!
points: A sector is the region between two radii and the arc joining them.
Area of a sector of angle θ = (θ/360) × πr².
A quadrant (θ = 90°) has area πr²/4, and a semicircle (θ = 180°) has area πr²/2.
Area of the major sector = πr² − area of the minor sector.
Also, area of a sector = ½ × arc length × r.

example.q: Find the area of a sector of angle 60° in a circle of radius 6 cm. (π = 3.14)

learn.reallife: Garden sprinklers that turn through a fixed angle water a sector-shaped patch of lawn.

items.text: Area of a 90° sector with r = 14 cm (π = 22/7) = ___ cm²

games.title: Slice sense
items: Area of a sector = (θ/360) × πr².
It is the fraction θ/360 of the whole circle's area.
A sector of 360° is the whole circle.
360° is a full turn.
Doubling the angle of a sector doubles its area.
Area is directly proportional to θ.
Doubling the radius of a sector doubles its area.
Area depends on r², so it becomes 4 times.
A quadrant has an angle of 45°.
A quadrant is a quarter circle, so its angle is 90°.
Area of a sector = ½ × arc length × radius.

quiz.q: What is the area of a 90° sector of a circle of radius 7 cm? (π = 22/7)
quiz.mistake: Gives the whole circle's area (154 cm²)

quiz.q: A clock's minute hand is 14 cm long. What area does it sweep in 5 minutes? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: In 5 minutes it turns 30°, which is 1/12 of a circle. Area = 1/12 × 22/7 × 196 = 616/12 ≈ 51.33 cm².
quiz.mistake: Finds the arc length (7.33 cm) instead of the area

quiz.q: What is the area of a 120° sector of a circle of radius 21 cm? (π = 22/7)
quiz.mistake: Uses 2/3 of the circle (the major sector)

quiz.q: A circle has radius 10 cm. What is the area of the major sector if the minor sector makes 72° at the centre? (π = 3.14)
quiz.mistake: Gives the minor sector area (62.8 cm²)

quiz.q: Riya's round pizza has radius 14 cm and is cut into 8 equal slices. What is the area of one slice? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: Whole pizza = 22/7 × 196 = 616 cm². One slice = 616 ÷ 8 = 77 cm².
quiz.mistake: Uses the circumference instead of the area

quiz.q: A sector's area is one-sixth of the circle's area. What angle does it make at the centre?
quiz.mistake: Divides 180° instead of 360° by 6

quiz.q: A goat is tied with a 14 m rope at one corner of a large square field. What area can it graze inside the field? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: The corner is 90°, so the goat grazes a quadrant: 1/4 × 22/7 × 196 = 154 m².
quiz.mistake: Uses the full circle instead of a quadrant

quiz.q: A 90° sector has area 154 cm². What is the radius? (π = 22/7)
quiz.mistake: Forgets that the sector is only a quarter of the circle

teach.ask: Gappu stares at a slice of pizza: 'How do I find the area of just this slice?'
teach.praise: Chirp chirp! Angle out of 360 times πr². Now I know exactly how much pizza I'm eating!
teach.nudge: What fraction of the circle is my slice, and the area of what do I multiply it by?

learn.hook: Cut a round roti with one straight slice — the small piece is a segment. Here's how to find its area!
points: A segment is the region between a chord and the arc it cuts off.
Area of the minor segment = area of the sector − area of ΔOAB (O is the centre).
If ∠AOB = 90°, area of ΔOAB = ½ × r × r = r²/2.
If ∠AOB = 60°, ΔOAB is equilateral with area (√3/4) r².
Area of the major segment = πr² − area of the minor segment.

example.q: A chord of a circle of radius 14 cm makes a right angle at the centre. Find the area of the minor segment. (π = 22/7)

learn.reallife: Window makers calculate the glass in arched windows — the curved top above a straight bar is a segment.

quiz.q: In a circle of radius 20 cm, a chord makes a right angle at the centre. What is the area of the minor segment? (π = 3.14)
quiz.explain: Sector = 1/4 × 3.14 × 400 = 314 cm². Triangle = ½ × 20 × 20 = 200 cm². Segment = 314 − 200 = 114 cm².
quiz.mistake: Gives the sector area and forgets to subtract the triangle

quiz.q: For the same circle (radius 20 cm, right angle at the centre), what is the area of the major segment? (π = 3.14)
quiz.explain: Circle area = 3.14 × 400 = 1256 cm². Major segment = 1256 − 114 = 1142 cm².
quiz.mistake: Gives the major sector (942 cm²) instead of the major segment

quiz.q: A chord of a circle of radius 6 cm makes 60° at the centre O. What kind of triangle is OAB?
quiz.explain: OA = OB = 6 cm, so the base angles are equal: (180° − 60°)/2 = 60°. All angles are 60°, so the triangle is equilateral.
quiz.mistake: Thinks only the angle at O is 60°

quiz.q: A chord of a circle of radius 12 cm makes 60° at the centre. Using π = 3.14 and √3 = 1.73, what is the area of the minor segment?
quiz.mistake: Adds the triangle to the sector instead of subtracting

quiz.q: Which statement gives the area of a minor segment?
options: Area of the sector + area of ΔOAB
Area of the circle − area of the sector
Area of the sector − area of ΔOAB
quiz.explain: The sector is made of the triangle OAB plus the segment, so the segment = sector − triangle.
quiz.mistake: Confuses the segment with the major sector

quiz.q: A round roti of radius 28 cm is cut along a chord that makes a right angle at the centre. What is the area of the smaller piece? (π = 22/7)
quiz.explain: Sector = 1/4 × 22/7 × 784 = 616 cm². Triangle = ½ × 28 × 28 = 392 cm². Segment = 616 − 392 = 224 cm².
quiz.mistake: Stops at the sector area

quiz.q: What is the area of ΔOAB if ∠AOB = 90° and the radius is 8 cm?
quiz.explain: OA and OB are perpendicular, so area = ½ × 8 × 8 = 32 cm².
quiz.mistake: Forgets the ½ in the triangle formula

quiz.q: A circle has area 154 cm² and its minor segment has area 30 cm². What is the area of the major segment?
quiz.explain: The two segments together make the whole circle: 154 − 30 = 124 cm².
quiz.mistake: Adds the areas instead of subtracting

teach.ask: Gappu cut a roti with one straight line: 'How do I find the area of the small piece?'
teach.praise: Tweet! Sector minus triangle gives the segment. My roti maths is perfect!
teach.nudge: Which two areas do I need, and do I add or subtract them?
